summary: The note is a short encyclopedic entry on the Malchiostro Annunciation, a painting by the Italian Renaissance artist Titian. It states the work was completed around 1520 and is housed in the Cathedral of Treviso in northern Italy.
one_line: Titian's Malchiostro Annunciation, c. 1520, is a painting housed in the Cathedral of Treviso, northern Italy.
key_facts: Malchiostro Annunciation is a painting by the Italian Renaissance artist Titian.
The Malchiostro Annunciation was completed around 1520.
The Malchiostro Annunciation is housed in the Cathedral of Treviso, northern Italy.
